newsitem.title: INDIA: India Nov-Jan soymeal export contracts at 505,000T.
newsitem.headline: India Nov-Jan soymeal export contracts at 505,000T.

text.p: Indian soymeal exporters have signed contracts to export 505,000 tonnes of soymeal for November, December and January shipments, traders said on Friday.
Main buyers were two Singapore-based companies, Peter Cremer and G. Premjee, who had brought 150,000 and 50,000 tonnes respectively.
Cargill Hong Kong Ltd had brought 60,000 tonnes and another Hong Kong-based firm, Concordia, had contracted for 65,000.
Germany's Toeffer International had signed deals for 95,000 tonnes.
Details of the remaining contracts were not available, traders said.
OILFED, M.M.T.C., State Trading Corporation (STC), Gujarat Ambuja Protein, Prestige Foods Ltd and Ruchi Soya Industries were the main sellers.
Traders said soymeal for November-January shipments were currently quoted at $275-276 F.A.S (free alongside ship).
Soymeal export prices had fallen over the week from $280 per tonne as new supplies had started arriving in central Indian markets, the hub of India's soybean industry.
Industry officials have estimated the 1996/97 (Nov-Oct) soybean crop at 4.4 million tonnes against 4.2 million last year.
